description: Pinned T-SQL probes that SqlToolsService's Edit Data feature emits when the user invokes 'Edit Top N Rows' on a table. Edit Data opens a SELECT on the target table, asks for column metadata, administers in-cell edits, and persists them as UPDATE/INSERT/DELETE statements in an implicit transaction. Iridium supports the simple heap-table subset (int/varchar/datetime columns with defaults and a single-column integer primary key). Unsupported table families (columnstore/temporal/graph/memory-optimized) are reported as not editable via sys.tables columns.
status_note: JSON-RPC framing not exercised; only T-SQL contract asserted. Unsupported table families surfaced via editability probe returning is_editable=0.

requests.tds_probe: SELECT TOP (200) t.name, SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id), c.name, ty.name, c.is_identity, c.is_computed, c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.MyTable') ORDER BY c.column_id
SELECT t.name, t.is_memory_optimized, t.temporal_type, t.is_edge, t.is_node FROM sys.tables t WHERE t.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.MyTable')
UPDATE dbo.MyTable SET col1=@p1 WHERE id=@p2
SELECT col1 FROM dbo.MyTable WHERE id=@p1
